$comment: idp-admin.py's per-deployment config. Install as /srv/idp/config/idp-admin.json (root 0600) or point IDP_ADMIN_CONFIG at it. Unknown keys are refused. After changing applications or delegations run `idp-admin.py roles-setup` (and `roles-setup --retire-app <client>` for an application you removed).

app-a.$comment: An application with a delegated role-group tree /app-a/<ROLE> (one group per client role, created by roles-setup). userManagerRole: the app-a client role every holder of /roles/app-a-user-manager must also hold (omit for no per-application manager).

app-a-admin.$comment: The application's own administrator service account (set up by fgap/app_admin_fgap.py): the role groups it may write membership of. Never list groups only the IdP's administrators may grant.

app-a-reader-delegate.$comment: A membership-only delegate (no realm-management role; created by `idp-admin.py delegate-setup app-a-reader-delegate`).
app-a-reader-delegate.name: app-a reader delegate (partner-reader membership only)

app-b.$comment: An application without delegates: its managers are the holders of /roles/app-b-user-manager who also hold app-b:owner.

handoffIntake.$comment: Optional: an application's hand-off intake (requests the application files for the IdP team). `idp-admin.py handoff-worker-setup` creates clientId (client credentials, no roles; one optional client scope `scope` carrying an audience mapper for `audience`); `idp-admin.py handoffs` lists the open hand-offs from url and records outcomes; app is the filing application, and only members of its tree get a suggested command.
